description: Calendar invitation responses through Thunderbird's own mail and Exchange plumbing.

functions.name: serverResponse
functions.description: Whether the invitation's account can respond on the server (Exchange): the meeting is then accepted on the user's calendar too.

functions.name: respond
functions.description: Respond to an Exchange meeting request the way Outlook does (AcceptItem / TentativelyAcceptItem / DeclineItem): updates the user's Exchange calendar and, unless send is false, sends the organizer a meeting response (with an optional note).

functions.name: meetingStatus
functions.description: For a meeting request or cancellation in an Exchange mailbox: the user's current response, whether a newer version exists, and whether the meeting is on their calendar. Null for other accounts.

functions.name: removeFromCalendar
functions.description: Remove a cancelled meeting from the user's Exchange calendar (Outlook's Remove from Calendar).

functions.name: calendarView
functions.description: Events on the calendars of the user's Exchange accounts between two instants (at most two months), recurring meetings expanded. With details, each event also has its plain-text body (for join links).

functions.name: sendReply
functions.description: Send an iMIP reply (RFC 6047) built exactly like Thunderbird's own invitation responses: text plus an inline text/calendar; method=REPLY part, and an invite.ics copy.

functions.name: calendars
functions.description: The calendars Ember can reach: each Exchange account's main calendar, and Thunderbird's own calendars (Google and other CalDAV calendars, subscriptions, local ones): { accountId, name, email, kind, group, color?, readOnly?, google? }.

functions.name: eventDetails
functions.description: One calendar event with its plain-text notes and its organizer and attendees (with their answers when Exchange tracks them).

functions.name: createEvent
functions.description: Make an event on an Exchange account's calendar. With attendees, Exchange sends them the invitation.

functions.name: updateEvent
functions.description: Change an event the user owns (this occurrence, or the series). With send, its attendees get the update.

functions.name: deleteEvent
functions.description: Delete an event (to Deleted Items). With cancel, the attendees get a cancellation (and the note).

functions.name: availability
functions.description: Busy times of some people from Exchange (GetUserAvailability), between two instants (a week at most).

functions.name: otherCalendars
functions.description: Each Exchange account's other calendars: its extra calendar folders, and the shared calendars in its Outlook calendar list.

functions.name: sharedView
functions.description: Events of other calendars between two instants (two months at most): in full when the user may read them, else busy times.

functions.name: respondEvent
functions.description: Answer a meeting from its entry on the user's Exchange calendar (accept, tentative or decline), telling the organizer.

functions.name: connectable
functions.description: Mail accounts (not Exchange) whose calendars Thunderbird could connect: { accountId, name, email, google, connected }.

functions.name: connectCalendars
functions.description: Find a mail account's calendars as Thunderbird's account setup does (Google's through its sign-in) and add the new ones to Thunderbird: { added, found }.

functions.name: findInvitation
functions.description: The user's copy of an invitation (by UID) on a Thunderbird calendar they can answer from, or null.
